entities.name: Spirit Fragment (Preceding Spirit 40)

attributes.appearance: Human Shape at the request of the Exorcist, speak with a hoarse Voice
attributes.functions: build Houses and High Towers, bring to thy Knowledge Enemies' Desires and Thoughts, giveth Good Familiars

entities.raw_quote: He is a Mighty President and Powerful. He can build Houses and High Towers... He governeth 40 Legions of Spirits

entities.name: Raum

attributes.appearance: Form of a Crow, but after the Command of the Exorcist he putteth on Human Shape
attributes.functions: steal Treasures out King's Houses, destroy Cities and Dignities of Men, tell all things Past, Present, and What Will Be, cause Love between Friends and Foes

entities.raw_quote: The Fortieth Spirit is Räum. He is a Great Earl; and appeareth at first in the Form of a Crow... governeth 30 Legions of Spirits

entities.name: Focalor

attributes.appearance: Form of a Man with Gryphon's Wings
attributes.functions: slay Men, drown them in the Waters, overthrow Ships of War, Power over both Winds and Seas
attributes.order: hopes to return to the Seventh Throne after 1,000 years

entities.raw_quote: The Forty-first Spirit is Focalor... He appeareth in the Form of a Man with Gryphon's Wings. His office is to slay Men, and to drown them in the Waters

entities.name: Vepar

attributes.functions: govern the Waters, guide Ships laden with Arms... cause the seas to be right stormy, maketh men to die in Three Days by Putrefying Wounds

entities.raw_quote: The Forty-second Spirit is Vepar... appeareth like a Mermaid. His office is to govern the Waters, and to guide Ships laden with Arms

entities.name: Sabnock

attributes.appearance: Form of an Armed Soldier with a Lion's Head, riding on a pale-coloured horse
attributes.functions: build high Towers, Castles and Cities, furnish them with Armour... afflict Men for many days with Wounds and with Sores rotten and full of Worms

entities.raw_quote: The Forty-third Spirit... is called Sabnock... appearing in the Form of an Armed Soldier with a Lion's Head, riding on a pale-coloured horse

entities.name: Shax

attributes.appearance: Form of a Stock-Dove, speaking with a voice hoarse, but yet subtle
attributes.functions: take away the Sight, Hearing, or Understanding... steal money out of the houses of Kings... discover all things that are Hidden

entities.raw_quote: The Forty-fourth Spirit is Shax... appeareth in the Form of a Stock-Dove... His Office is to take away the Sight, Hearing, or Understanding of any Man or Woman

entities.name: Viné

attributes.appearance: Form of a Lion riding upon a Black Horse, and bearing a Viper in his hand
attributes.functions: discover Things Hidden, Witches, Wizards... build Towers, overthrow Great Stone Walls, make the Waters rough with Storms

entities.raw_quote: The Forty-fifth Spirit is Viné... appeareth in the Form of a Lion riding upon a Black Horse... His Office is to discover Things Hidden, Witches, Wizards

entities.name: Bifrons

attributes.appearance: Form of a Monster; but after a while... putteth on the shape of a Man
attributes.functions: make one knowing in Astrology, Geometry... teacheth the Virtues of Precious Stones and Woods... changeth Dead Bodies

entities.raw_quote: The Forty-sixth Spirit is called Bifrons... appeareth in the Form of a Monster; but after a while, at the Command of the Exorcist, he putteth on the shape of a Man

entities.name: Vual

attributes.appearance: Form of a Mighty Dromedary at the first... putteth on Human Shape, and speaketh the Egyptian Tongue
attributes.functions: procure the Love of Woman, tell Things Past, Present, and to Come, procureth Friendship between Friends and Foes

entities.raw_quote: The Forty-seventh Spirit Uvall, or Vual... appeareth in the Form of a Mighty Dromedary at the first... His Office is to procure the Love of Woman

entities.name: Haagenti

attributes.appearance: Form of a Mighty Bull with Gryphon's Wings... putteth on Human Shape
attributes.functions: make Men wise... Transmute all Metals into Gold; and to change Wine into Water, and Water into Wine

entities.raw_quote: The Forty-eighth Spirit is Haagenti. He is a President, appearing in the Form of a Mighty Bull with Gryphon's Wings... Transmute all Metals into Gold

entities.name: Crocell

attributes.appearance: Form of an Angel... speaking something Mystically of Hidden Things
attributes.functions: teacheth the Art of Geometry and the Liberal Sciences... produce Great Noises like the Rushings of many Waters, warmeth Waters

entities.raw_quote: The Forty-ninth Spirit is Crocell... He is a Duke Great and Strong... teacheth the Art of Geometry and the Liberal Sciences

entities.name: Furcas

attributes.appearance: Form of a Cruel Old Man with a long Beard and a hoary Head, riding upon a pale-coloured Horse, with a Sharp Weapon in his hand
attributes.functions: teach the Arts of Philosophy, Astrology, Rhetoric, Logic, Cheiromancy, and Pyromancy

entities.raw_quote: The Fiftieth Spirit is Furcas. He is a Knight... appeareth in the Form of a Cruel Old Man with a long Beard... teach the Arts of Philosophy, Astrology

entities.name: Balam

attributes.appearance: three Heads: Bull, Man, Ram... Tail of a Serpent, Flaming Eyes. rideth upon a furious Bear, carrieth a Boshawk upon his Fist
attributes.functions: give True Answers of Things Past, Present, and to Come. maketh men to go Invisible, and also to be Witty

entities.raw_quote: The Fifty-first Spirit is Balam... appeareth with three Heads: the first is like that of a Bull; the second is like that of a Man; the third is like that of a Ram

entities.name: Alloces

attributes.appearance: Form of a Soldier riding upon a Great Horse. Face is like that of a Lion, very Red, and having Flaming Eyes
attributes.functions: teach the Art of Astronomy, and all the Liberal Sciences. bringeth unto thee Good Familiars

entities.raw_quote: The Fifty-second Spirit is Alloces... appearing in the Form of a Soldier riding upon a Great Horse. His Face is like that of a Lion, very Red
